text_block_list.text:
I spotted Ikuno Dictus inspecting the 
course all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If we set up the starting gate at that 
position, considering the distance from 
the stands... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was put in charge of preparing the mock 
races for the upcoming orientation, so I'm 
conducting a preliminary inspection.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, pardon me, but could you step 
aside? I need to measure the width of the 
course.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely those qualities that were 
recognized, which is why this task was 
entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If cutting corners leads to a major 
incident, there won't even be an 
orientation to speak of.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I still have things left to 
attend to, so I shall take my leave...
choice_data_list: Are you going to do all of it alone?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even though I was the only one tasked 
with this, it won't be an issue if I work 
efficiently.

No matter how adept she was, it had to be 
tough on her own, so I considered calling 
out to help, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Ikuno's trying to take care of 
everything all by herself again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you to rely on me whenever 
you're given a difficult task?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, the one entrusted with this was 
me—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, wouldn't doing it together 
get it done way faster than doing it all 
by yourself~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Now then, you two take one 
flag each—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My apologies. I must give out 
instructions, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I want to get a grasp of how it looks from 
the stands, so please stand at the near 
and far corners and wave your flags. After 
that—

It seems she's well-liked by her friends. 
Looks like there's no need for me to step 
in and help.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, naturally. There's no way I wouldn't 
put my whole heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Guests from outside will be attending the 
orientation.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Among them are Umamusume who will one day 
enroll in this academy...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I want those girls to be able to enjoy 
themselves safely and to their hearts' 
content.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Though, to be fair, that is not the only 
reason.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From the perspective of an event to 
revitalize the local community, this 
orientation needs to be designed so that 
people of all ages and genders can enjoy 
it—

I came to understand Ikuno Dictus's 
passion for the orientation and her 
deliberate design to make it as enjoyable 
as possible...
